product.description: Monoprice™DisplayPort® 1.4 Cable to 8K HDMI® - 6 FeetNext Generation Technology Delivers 8K@60Hz Performance, Up To 32.4Gbps BandwidthIntroducing the Monoprice™ DisplayPort 1.4 to 8K HDMI Cable, the perfect solution for connecting your HDMI® video display to a DisplayPort® source. Whether you want to connect your video game console, Apple TV®, or laptop computer to your HDMI® display, this cable is designed to meet your needs with superior performance and reliability.This cable is built to comply with the DisplayPort 1.4 standard, which ensures a high‑quality connection between your devices. With a maximum data transfer rate of up to 32.4Gbps, it provides ample bandwidth to deliver stunning video and audio signals without any loss in quality. This high‑speed cable supports video resolutions of up to 8K@60Hz, allowing you to enjoy crystal‑clear visuals with smooth playback and vibrant colors.With support for resolutions up to 8K@60Hz and 4K@120Hz, this cable is future‑proofed to handle the latest advancements in display technology. Whether you're a content creator, a gamer, or a home theater enthusiast, you can trust this cable to deliver an immersive visual experience like never before. Immerse yourself in the world of lifelike graphics and fluid motion, taking your entertainment to the next level.The Monoprice DisplayPort 1.4 to 8K HDMI Cable is not only high‑performing but also highly versatile. It is backward compatible with older DisplayPort® standards, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of devices. Whether you have a newer DisplayPort‑equipped device or an older one, this cable has you covered, allowing you to connect your devices seamlessly.It is important to note that this cable is unidirectional, meaning it can only connect a DisplayPort® source to an HDMI® display. It is not designed to connect an HDMI‑equipped computer or video source to a DisplayPort display. Please ensure that you are using the cable in the correct configuration to avoid any connectivity issues.To ensure your peace of mind, the Monoprice DisplayPort 1.4 to 8K HDMI Cable comes with the Monoprice™ Lifetime Warranty. Monoprice is committed to providing top‑notch quality and exceptional customer service, and this warranty reflects their confidence in their product. Rest assured that you are making a reliable and durable investment when you choose this cable.In summary, the Monoprice DisplayPort 1.4 to 8K HDMI Cable offers high‑performance connectivity, supporting resolutions up to 8K@60Hz and 4K@120Hz. With a maximum data transfer rate of 32.4Gbps, it ensures flawless transmission of video and audio signals. Its compatibility with older DisplayPort® standards and unidirectional design make it a versatile choice for connecting your HDMI® display to a DisplayPort® source. Trust in Monoprice's commitment to quality with the included Lifetime Warranty.
